name: Environmental Enhancement Contestable Fund
summary: Small grants, funded with Hawke's Bay Regional Council and Eastern & Central Community Trust, for projects that restore native ecosystems and species in Hawke's Bay or build community involvement in biodiversity. The next round is expected to open in March 2027.

eligibility.rule: Project activity has not started before grant approval
No more than one application per applicant per funding round
Funded work occurs within 12 months after grant approval

status.quote: Applications for our next funding round are due to open in March 2027.

applicant_types.quote: Annually, we offer a small number of grants to individuals and organisations in Hawke's Bay

geography.quote: Annually, we offer a small number of grants to individuals and organisations in Hawke's Bay

access.quote: How to apply Environmental Enhancement Contestable Fund Application Form

window.quote: Applications for our next funding round are due to open in March 2027.

amount.quote: $1,000-3,000 to support smaller or early-stage projects $3,001-15,000 to support larger or more established projects

effort.quote: All applications for funding and reporting must be entered electronically on the forms provided.
Applications will be reviewed and assessed within two months of the closing date and all applicants will be notified of the outcome of their application via email.

eligibility.quote: Biodiversity Hawke's Bay does not fund retrospectively. The activity being considered for funding must not start prior to a grant being approved.
Only one application per applicant, per funding round, can be made to the Environmental Enhancement Contestable Fund.
The funding period is 12 months from when the grant is approved. The funded work must occur within this time period.
Minimum amount of funding that can be applied for is $1,000 and the maximum amount of funding that will be granted is $15,000 per funding round.

after_award.quote: All applications for funding and reporting must be entered electronically on the forms provided.
